name: code2video-web
description: Convert an HTML/JavaScript animation into an MP4 video, in the browser (WebCodecs) or on a server (Playwright + ffmpeg).

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix client test && npm --prefix server test
scripts.test:unit: npm --prefix client test && npm --prefix server run test:unit
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix client run typecheck && npm --prefix server run typecheck
